description: Read one version of a House or Senate bill as plain text from its official XML: the introduction (recommendation, summary, preamble, enacting clause), headings, numbered body sections, and schedules. Omitted publicationId reads the last-listed version in canparl_get_bill publications; omitted session means the verified current official session. Text over 24000 bytes returns an outline of segment counts and the outermost headings, each with its body offset and count; re-call with one segment and follow pagination.nextOffset. Sections are never split. A version exported only as a PDF, as in many older sessions, has no text here.

billCode.description: Bill code from canparl_search_bills, including a split-bill suffix letter such as C-15A; accepts bill s321, S321, S 321, or S-321.

language.description: Text language: en (default) reads the English XML, fr the French.

limit.description: Whole records per page of segment headings, body, or schedules: default 50 headings or 5 sections or schedules, 1–100 per call; larger values up to 10000 return 100 with a notice.

offset.description: Zero-based whole-record offset in segment headings, body, or schedules, default 0; a heading's offset is the body offset of its first section.

publicationId.description: Publication ID from canparl_get_bill publications; omit for the last-listed (furthest-stage) version.

segment.description: One segment: introduction, headings, body, schedules. Omit for the whole text, or its outline above the 24000-byte threshold.

name: canparl_get_bill_text

publicationId.description: Publication read: the requested one, or the last-listed by default.

bill.description: Official bill summary, as canparl_search_bills returns it.

billCode.description: Canonical House or Senate bill code.

chamber.description: Chamber of the latest completed major stage, or null; royal assent is reported as Senate.

name.description: Latest completed major stage name, or null.

latestMajorStage.description: Latest completed major stage, or null.

en.description: English text, or null when unavailable.

fr.description: French text, or null when unavailable.

royalAssentDate.description: Royal assent as a UTC instant ending in Z (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.fraction]Z), converted from LEGISinfo's Ottawa-time clock, or null; the time of day is LEGISinfo's recorded time, which can differ from when assent was signified. A value in another shape is relayed as published.

en.description: English text, or null when unavailable.

fr.description: French text, or null when unavailable.

body.description: Top-level body sections in document order.

items.description: One top-level body section, never split.

explanatoryNotes.description: Explanatory notes on existing text, never enacted text, kept apart from the text; or null.

items.description: One enclosing heading: its label and title, space-joined.

label.description: Section label, such as 224, or null.

text.description: Whole section text: one line per block, labels opening their line, table cells joined by " | "; or null.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_text_segment`: offset or limit supplied without segment headings, body, or schedules. `unknown_publication`: publicationId is not one of the bill's publications. `bill_text_unavailable`: The bill lists no publications, or the version has no XML text: a PDF-only or table-of-contents export, a missing viewer page, or a missing XML file. `unknown_session`: Session with a zero or out-of-range number, or absent from the official bill session index. `bill_not_found`: Official dossier has no matching record or returns a missing-record response. `upstream_blocked`: An official parliamentary source refuses the request with HTTP 403. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

headings.description: Body headings of every level in document order; an outline lists only the outermost level.

items.description: Body heading and the run of body sections it spans.

characters.description: Text length of the spanned sections in UTF-16 code units, for sizing a body page.

citation.description: Citation printed under the heading (its MarginalNote, such as a HistoricalNote), or null.

count.description: Body sections under this heading, up to the next heading of the same or a higher level.

firstLabel.description: Label of the first spanned body section, or null when count is 0.

index.description: Position in the headings segment; pass it as offset with segment headings.

label.description: Heading label, such as PART 5 or DIVISION 9, or null.

lastLabel.description: Label of the last spanned body section, or null when count is 0.

offset.description: Body offset of the first section under this heading; pass it with segment body.

introduction.description: Text before the body as plain text; the table of provisions is left to the outline and headings.

explanatoryNotes.description: Explanatory notes on existing text, never enacted text, kept apart from the text; or null.

recommendation.description: Royal recommendation, opening with its title line, or null.

summary.description: Summary, opening with its SUMMARY line, or null.

kind.description: Absent for the whole text; outline lists segments; segment returns one selection.

pagination.description: Whole-record continuation of a headings, body, or schedules page.

limit.description: Effective maximum page size after the per-call cap.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page, or null when the segment is complete.

provenance.description: Original retrieval metadata for every source request.

cached.description: Whether this response came from the in-memory cache.

publication.description: The version read: its dossier publication record and the identity its XML prints.

longTitle.description: Long title printed in this version, or null.

shortTitle.description: Short title printed in this version, or null.

sponsor.description: Sponsor as printed, or null; Royal Assent versions print none.

stage.description: Stage the XML names, as published (such as first-reading-senate or assented-to), or null.

type.description: Publication type wording, such as First Reading or Royal Assent.

en.description: English text, or null when unavailable.

fr.description: French text, or null when unavailable.

url.description: Official DocumentViewer page of this version in the text language.

xmlUrl.description: Official XML the text was read from.

explanatoryNotes.description: Explanatory notes on existing text, never enacted text, kept apart from the text; or null.

label.description: Schedule label, such as SCHEDULE 1, or null.

originatingRef.description: Provision the schedule belongs to, such as (Section 12), or null.

text.description: Whole schedule text, nested schedules included, in the section text format; or null.

segments.description: Segment selectors with their record counts; outline only.

count.description: Record count; null for introduction, which returns whole.

totalCount.description: Records in the selected headings, body, or schedules segment; paged segments only.

title: Canparl Get Bill Text
